en-US.title: [KOREAN JJIMJILBANG] Experience a Korean sauna (Jjimjilbang)
en-US.description:
Johanna, an Austrian woman who had been living in Korea for a year and a half, had heard countless stories about Korean saunas (Jjimjilbang), but she had never actually set foot in one. Finally, she decided to take the plunge and experience a Jjimjilbang for herself.
Upon entering, she was initially bewildered by the unique culture. Seeing people sleeping on the floor in matching pajamas and rubbing salt on their bodies was a bit of a culture shock. However, as she started soaking in the warm mineral water and sweating out her stress in the charcoal room, her confusion turned into comfort.
By the time she was sipping cold sikhye (sweet rice drink) and cracking sauna-baked eggs, she found herself completely captivated by the charm of the Jjimjilbang. What started as a confusing visit ended with Johanna becoming a total fan of the Korean spa experience...
